subject: delta(client): WF record a stop or re-hold that the effect boundary raises while signing or the connector raises before the first byte
note: A host stop or a re-hold that the effect boundary raises while a seller request is signed, or that the connector's transmit step raises before the first byte, now records state.protocol.sellerSuspension through the attempt's new refused(error), before the attempt's own outcome; on the two read routes only queued work records one. A host stop the connector wrapped now rejects as the stop's own OperationError and leaves the attempt unknown; a re-hold still rejects as an unsent SellerUnavailableError. profile_not_admitted counts as a re-hold only while purchases are held. Restated tests: the two effect-path tests that expected an unsent SellerUnavailableError for a stop refused before the first byte now expect the stop's OperationError. The request-boundary test helper takes an optional clock for the bounded stop-check timeout.
